page.running_head: Scutum Regium / LIB. II. / De obedientia Christianorum erga Valerianum, Imperat. sub Persecutione octava.

main_text.p: jam sine omni controversia satis virium nacti, tum ad defendendos, tum ad offendendos hostes, excōmunicationis & degradationis fulmen in Imperatoris caput ejaculantur? Certè, ut verbo expediam, quod eos non tam defectus virium, quàm conscientiae, ad præcepta Saluatoris, & Apostolorum praxim regulatae vox intra gyros civilis obedientiae coarctaret.
main_text.head: CAP. VIII.
main_text.p: {n}Priusquàm ad Valeriani Imperium accedamus operæprætium erit hoc in loco, Dionysij Episcopi Alexandrini verba attexere, ex Epistola ad Hermammonem, quam citat {n}Eusebius vbi de Triboniano Gallo, qui Decio suo succes- Lib.7.1.sit infit; [Gallus neq; Decij recogitauit calamitatem, neque antea secum quid tandem illum (nempe Decium) de gradu dejecisset diligenter consi- de-

page.notes: The word "Apostolorum" is set in italic with a large decorated initial A, which I read as A and not as Greek. The initial is hard to read and may be a different letter; the reading is doubtful.
